in_marathi.name: Mithalesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mithilesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Mithila and Ishana. Mithila is a reference to the Moon God, Chandra, while Ishana signifies the lord or ruler. Thus, Mithilesh can be interpreted as the 'ruler of the moon'.
